# `usage_charge`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

The rating of one usage record of a pay-as-you-go line: the pass that rated it (a usage command), the usage price applied and the ABR that charged its line, kind and day. The primary key is what keeps a record from ever being charged twice. Without a price (the offering has none for the kind) or with a zero price there is no charge (abr_id null).

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `usage_record_id` | `uuid` | no |  | The rated usage record. No foreign key: the record's partition is dropped after 13 months and its charge stays as billing evidence. |
| `command_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `product_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `price_id` | `uuid` | yes |  |  |
| `abr_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | The oneTime ABR that charged the group of the record; null when nothing was charged. |
| `blocks` | `bigint` | yes |  | Blocks charged for the whole group of the record (its line, event date and kind in the pass), rounded up once; the same on each record of the group. |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
